snippet.title: Infamous Keepers - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Infamous Keepers, a tower defense dungeon crawling roguelike developed by Goblinz Studio. Players will use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing. Infamous Keepers is launching in 2027 for PC (Steam).
